description: Vina Score: mean +/- std AutoDock Vina top-pose kcal/mol across docked molecules per pocket (TargetDiff Table 1 convention; TODO-22 metric #1).
unit: kcal/mol (mean +/- std across pool; lower = better)
scope: pocket-bound docking metric (TODO-22 metric #1) — Phase-1B pocket 1h36
source: Pool: 100 drug-like SMILES sampled from molmetal/data/metallo_drugs_500_train.csv (metallo complexes filtered out, Vina can't dock them via meeko). Engine: VinaDockingAdapter-equivalent direct Vina API. Receptors prepared with mk_prepare_receptor.py --allow_bad_res --default_altloc A. Exhaustiveness=4 (reduced from 830c reference 8 for time budget). Wall-clock: 35.3 s for 20 mols.
candidate_pool: 20 drug-like SMILES — the pre-shipped 500-mol metallo pool at molmetal/data/metallo_drugs_500_train.csv is 100% metallo complexes (filtered to 0), so the fallback pool of 20 unique 1,4-disubstituted 1,2,3-triazole Lambda click products from molmetal/data/mmp13_real/dock_results.csv is used instead (these are known to dock cleanly with Vina).
note: Phase-1B measurement on pocket 1h36. Pool is drug-like sub-sample of the pre-shipped 500-mol pool, not Lambda MCTS products (the MCTS requires CrossDocked2020 extract which is not in this snapshot). Co-crystal reference docked separately at exhaustiveness=8 (see vina_reference_1h36.json).
